response.title: what type of solar generator do i need
response.answer:
The type of solar generator you need depends on what you want to power, how long you need to run it, and whether you're using it for home backup, camping, or off-grid living.

A solar generator typically consists of a portable battery, an inverter, a charge controller, and optional solar panels.

Solar generator size guide

Small — 300–500 Wh

Phones, laptops, Wi-Fi routers, LED lights.

Best for camping and small electronics.

Medium — 1,000–2,000 Wh

Refrigerators, TVs, fans, computers, and small appliances.

Best for short power outages.

Large — 3,000–6,000 Wh

Multiple appliances, refrigerators, microwaves, and some air conditioners.

Best for extended home backup.

Whole-home — 10,000+ Wh

Multiple household circuits and potentially central AC, depending on system size.

Best for whole-home backup or off-grid use.
